hello.text: There you are, dear. You look peaky. Everyone does at first. Have you eaten? Never mind, we'll get to that.

t0.text: Waking tea, mostly. Waking herb, honey, a pinch of salt. Some swear by mint, but mint is for people who don't trust honey.

t1.text: Not yet, dear, I'm all out. Bring me what I ask for and you'll have some on the house.
